targets.note: The Overview tab of Rivera engagement: status, lead and due under the name, the strip, the goal and update, the next milestones, late and waiting, people. The prototype side is its Overview tab.
The Plan tab on the shared Plan, timeline view: stages as bands, bars, milestones, today line, dependency arrows. The prototype side is its Plan tab, timeline.
The Chat tab: the one project chat is the channel, each thread with its arrow-out mark. The prototype side is the project page; its chat tab opens the channel in Chats.
